OPENING SEQUENCE E — THE MOON BELL THEFT AND THE MISSION
MAIN LOCATION / EXACT SUBLOCATION: Old Blue Gate exterior for ticket marking; Entry Court beside the empty Moon Bell stand for the briefing
Speech placement: keep the existing line(s) close to TEZ; leave faces, hands, signs, cards, controls and mathematical evidence unobstructed.

printable.text: When something is mathematically wrong, ChandRush magic copies or exaggerates the mistake. Tez calls this Moon Mischief. A wrong number can make lights flash at the wrong time. A wrong fraction can make portions change size. A wrong shape can make part of a building behave as if the shape itself is confused.

panels.focus: Magic does not do the mathematics

printable.text: TEZ: Magic can show us that something is wrong. It cannot do the maths for us. We have to understand the mistake and fix the real thing.
